C1476.title: Star Map Universe Virtual Real Estate Scam
C1476.summary: In July 2024, Shenzhen police cracked a virtual real estate fraud case involving 3 billion yuan. The Star Map Universe platform inflated virtual land prices to 80,000 yuan per square meter, used 12,000 virtual accounts for self-buying and self-selling, fabricated transaction records to create fake activity, and used AI to generate fake street-view videos. Wenzhou merchant Lin spent 6.7 million yuan on a metaverse CBD core parcel that was only blockchain code, and police tracing found that 90% of the platform flow was self-trading.

references.title: Case Alert: "Metaverse Land" at 80,000 Per Ping Turns Out to Be from a Famous Cyberpunk Game
